rationale: The discourse has moved into quantified scenario comparison, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and state insist on no closures/no forced redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still require a structurally sufficient cost reset and reserve the closure option. Positions are stable and repeating, with no substantive convergence over the last two rounds, so further round-based negotiation is unlikely to add much without external mediation or a hard decision framework.
